$comment: Packages from the kitr package map that are not built yet. When a package with this name ships a kitr block, the site shows the real one and ignores this entry. status: building (in progress now), next, later (roadmap only).

packages.name: theme
packages.summary: Light, dark and system themes with no flash on load, and native title bars and status bars that match.

packages.name: platform
packages.summary: Know where your app is running, whether it is online or in the background, and handle the back button and deep links.

packages.name: web
packages.summary: Ship to the browser as a static site, a single-page app or a server-rendered app, installable if you want.

packages.name: mobile
packages.summary: Ship the same app to iPhone and Android, with every kitr package switched to its native version.

packages.name: desktop
packages.summary: Ship the same app to Windows, macOS and Linux in an Electron shell: Chromium ships with the app, so it renders the same everywhere.

packages.name: tauri
packages.summary: Ship the same app to Windows, macOS and Linux as a small Tauri binary on the operating system's webview.

packages.name: seo
packages.summary: Give every page a title, a share preview and a sitemap entry so search engines and chat apps show it well.

packages.name: realtime
packages.summary: Define a live channel once and push updates to every open screen, over WebSockets, Socket.IO or server events.

packages.name: offline
packages.summary: Keep showing loaded data with no connection, and send queued changes when the network comes back.

packages.name: flags
packages.summary: Turn features on for some users and off for others, with the same answer on the server and in the browser.

packages.name: secure-storage
packages.summary: Keep login tokens and secrets in the phone or computer's secure vault instead of plain storage.

packages.name: files
packages.summary: Let people open, save and pick files on any platform, with a download fallback in older browsers.

packages.name: notifications
packages.summary: Ask for permission and show local or scheduled notifications that open the right page when tapped.

packages.name: native
packages.summary: Clipboard, share sheet, haptics, location, camera and fingerprint unlock, each with a web fallback.

packages.name: updater
packages.summary: Tell people a new version is ready and update the app in place, on the web, desktop and mobile.

packages.name: cache
packages.summary: Remember slow results on the server and clear them by tag when the data changes.

packages.name: shield
packages.summary: Turn on the security basics every API needs: CORS, CSRF protection, safe headers and rate limits.

packages.name: mail
packages.summary: Write emails as React components, send them through your provider, and preview them in development.

packages.name: jobs
packages.summary: Run work in the background or on a schedule, with retries when it fails.

packages.name: uploads
packages.summary: Accept file uploads with size limits, store them on disk or in the cloud, and show progress in the browser.

packages.name: consent
packages.summary: Ask for cookie and tracking consent once, and hold analytics and error reports until people agree.

packages.name: local-db
packages.summary: A real database inside the app, on every platform, with one schema shared with the server.

packages.name: payments
packages.summary: Take payments and subscriptions, and check what each user has paid for, including in-app purchases.

packages.name: better-auth
packages.summary: Run kitr sign-in, sessions and permissions on Better Auth instead of writing your own.

packages.name: ai
packages.summary: Stream answers from AI models into your pages, with chat state kept alongside the rest of your data.

packages.name: push
packages.summary: Send push notifications from your server to phones and browsers, even when the app is closed.

packages.name: sync
packages.summary: Keep local data in step with the server automatically, so the app works the same online and offline.

packages.name: search
packages.summary: Add fast, typo-tolerant search over your data, with the index defined next to your models.
